handoff.purpose: Complete official-source BNU Fall 2026 requirements for every published undergraduate catalog row.

unresolvedNotes: This is a closed historical Fall 2026 route and must not be presented as a current application window.

sources.title: Beijing Normal University 2026 international undergraduate admission brochure
Beijing Normal University 2026 international undergraduate major catalog

requirements.ruleText: Observe Chinese laws and BNU rules, respect Chinese customs, demonstrate good moral character, have no criminal record, and be healthy enough to study and live independently in China.
Be a non-Chinese citizen holding a valid foreign passport and be 18 to 40 years old under the published 2026 date rule; applicants under 18 on September 1, 2026 must have a guardian in China.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants with a Chinese parent or former mainland, Hong Kong, Macao or Taiwan residence
requirements.ruleText: Meet the published foreign-nationality holding period and overseas-residence rules and provide the related entry-exit, naturalization, renunciation and household-registration records when applicable.

references.locator: Section II, item 3 and Section V, item 10

requirements.ruleText: Hold a qualification equivalent to a Chinese high-school graduation certificate or above.
Complete the online application from November 15, 2025 through March 15, 2026, China Standard Time. This is a closed historical intake.
Mail the required paper application records promptly using one of BNU's published delivery services; late paper materials terminate review and admission processing.
Register in BNU's international-student online application system, select Undergraduate Student, complete the form and upload all required materials. Up to two majors may be selected.
Pay the non-refundable CNY 500 online application fee; applications are not processed before payment.
Submit the original BNU International Undergraduate Students Application Form generated by the online system.

Submit the original notarized or authenticated high-school graduation certificate; expected graduates may submit the original expected-graduation certificate and must present the formal graduation certificate at registration.
Submit original, notarized or authenticated transcripts for every year and course of high school.
Submit a valid CSCA report for the exact subjects assigned to the selected major.

references.locator: Section V, item 4 and Section VI

requirements.ruleText: Submit the program-specific HSK certificate and transcript; the test date must be no earlier than November 1, 2023.
Submit a signed recommendation letter from a high-school teacher, head teacher or school leader.
Use BNU's personal-statement form, print it and complete it by hand in Chinese; a typed statement is not accepted.
Submit the passport information page; the passport must remain valid beyond March 31, 2027. Also provide the most recent Chinese visa and, when currently in China, the valid residence permit.
Submit a no-criminal-record certificate or the published commitment letter.
Submit the original notarized guardian certificate for the province or municipality of the teaching campus.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants with records not in Chinese or English
requirements.ruleText: Attach an original notarized Chinese or English translation to each non-Chinese and non-English document.
Attend the BNU interview for every selected major after notice through the application system and email.
Study full time for four years in Chinese.

Review the separately administered BNU New International Students Scholarship, Silk Road Muduo Scholarship, Beijing Government Scholarship, Chinese Government Scholarship and International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship; scholarship selection does not replace admission requirements.

Follow the campus-specific accommodation process. Beijing-campus applicants book after receiving the electronic admission notice during the published July 1 to August 15, 2026 window; Zhuhai-campus dormitories are assigned by Phoenix School and carry a published annual fee of CNY 7,500.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants in this exact program group
requirements.ruleText: Submit HSK Level 4, score 180 or above.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants in this exact program group
requirements.ruleText: Submit results for Chinese (Liberal Arts), Mathematics; take the subjects in Chinese.

requirements.appliesTo: Enrolled students in this exact program group
requirements.ruleText: Pay RMB 24,000 per academic year.
